plainLanguage: Change the angle your arm works at and you change which part of the chest muscle does most of the work.
qualifiers: Demonstrated in activation and in spectral EMG measures, not in force contribution.
Surface electromyography over this muscle carries a measurement qualifier that its own methods literature states plainly (see claim-pectoralis-major-surface-emg-limitation).
Samples of eight to twenty-four participants.

conditions: isometric shoulder tasks at defined elevation angles, and bench press at defined bench inclinations

statement: Which region of the pectoralis major is most active depends on the position of the humerus: regional activation differs by arm elevation angle and by the plane of the movement.
